images.caption:
Caribbean Motel on NRHP since August 24, 2005. At 5600 Ocean Ave. in Wildwood Crest (south of Wildwood), New Jersey in Cape May County. Built 1958 in a distinctive modern (Las Vegas? Jetsons?) style, aka Googie style, or locally "Doo-Wop". 
Second story office, photographer facing south.  Note the tilted glass, bright colors, huge neon sign, and the overhang without a roof

See also "Chateau Bleu" for another example of this style nearby.
images.alt:

Second story office, photographer facing south.  Note the tilted glass, bright colors, huge neon sign, and the overhang without a roof
